parts:

David

messages.author: 645e2b041ea2a63e
messages.subject: Re: Alternatives to normal distribution for manifest outcomes
parts:
Hi David,

Correct, we can currently handle ordinal variables and continuous variables, but they both involve the normal distribution.

If you edit the MCMC code to use different distributions, I would recommend target="jags". The Stan code takes advantage of multivariate normality to speed up sampling, and many of those tricks will not transfer to other distributions.

An example of editing JAGS code appears in Section 4.4 of the original blavaan paper:

https://www.jstatsoft.org/article/view/v085i04

Ed
